metadata.source: Authoritative Vendor Advisories (Rocky Linux, Red Hat, Debian, Ubuntu, CISA KEV, FIRST EPSS)

cisa_kev.vulnerabilityName: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Denial of Service Vulnerability
cisa_kev.shortDescription: Multiple HTTP/2 implementations are vulnerable to a denial of service attack where an attacker opens and resets streams rapidly.
cisa_kev.requiredAction: Apply vendor patches or disable HTTP/2.

cisa_kev.vulnerabilityName: Sudo Baron Samedit Local Privilege Escalation
cisa_kev.shortDescription: Heap-based buffer overflow in Sudo allows local privilege escalation to root.
Heap buffer overflow in libwebp allows remote code execution via a crafted WebP lossless image.

advisories.title: Sudo Heap-Based Buffer Overflow in Argument Parsing ('Baron Samedit')
advisories.description: A heap-based buffer overflow flaw was found in Sudo's command-line argument unescaping logic when operating in shell mode (sudoedit -s or sudo -s). When an argument terminates with a single trailing backslash character, the unescaping loop increments the read pointer past the terminating null byte, copying memory out-of-bounds into adjacent heap structures.
advisories.root_cause: Heap memory corruption in parse_args() via single unescaped trailing backslash in shell mode (-s).
advisories.remediation_text: Ensure sudo package is updated to the latest vendor errata build via DNF: sudo dnf update sudo
advisories.mitigation_text: If immediate updating is deferred, restrict access to authorized personnel via VPN and SSH keys; enable systemd auditd rules to monitor execution of /usr/bin/sudo and /usr/bin/sudoedit.
advisories.operational_impact: None. Sudo is a standalone client executable; updating does not interrupt active user sessions, running daemons, or require a system reboot.
compensating_controls: Perimeter Network Isolation: Host is strictly accessible via private VPN; no SSH port is exposed to the public internet.
Cryptographic Authentication: Password authentication is disabled; only authorized SSH private keys are accepted.
Population Control: Server is dedicated to backend services; no untrusted, multi-tenant, or guest local user accounts exist on the machine.
advisories.residual_risk: Low. If an external service (such as a web daemon) were compromised via an unauthenticated remote execution vulnerability, an adversary executing under the daemon's local service account could attempt local privilege escalation to root.

validation_steps.purpose: Queries RPM database for exact epoch, version, and vendor release.
Inspects binary changelog for authoritative vendor security backport commit.
validation_steps.expected_output: Resolves: CVE-2021-3156 (heap-based buffer overflow in command line parsing)

validation_steps.step: 3. File Permissions and SUID Bit Verification
validation_steps.purpose: Confirms standard file permissions and verifies binary ownership.

advisories.safe_verification_procedure: Defensive Verification Procedure: Inspect the package release and vendor security changelog using 'rpm -q --changelog sudo | grep -i CVE-2021-3156' to verify the presence of the vendor patch. Check file permissions on /usr/bin/sudo to ensure standard system ownership.

advisories.title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Protocol Denial of Service (DDoS)
advisories.description: The HTTP/2 protocol stream handling engine is vulnerable to a denial of service attack where an attacker continuously opens new streams and immediately resets them using RST_STREAM frames. This forces the server to process connection overhead while avoiding the concurrent stream limit, leading to high CPU exhaustion and denial of service.
advisories.root_cause: Protocol state resource exhaustion: continuous stream creation immediately followed by RST_STREAM cancellation frames.
advisories.remediation_text: Upgrade NGINX package to vendor fixed release 1:1.20.1-14.el9_2.3 or modern mainline release: sudo dnf update nginx
advisories.mitigation_text: Disable HTTP/2 support on listening sockets by removing 'http2' parameter from listen directives in /etc/nginx/nginx.conf.
advisories.operational_impact: Applying patch or configuration requires an NGINX configuration reload ('sudo nginx -s reload') or service restart. No host reboot required.
compensating_controls: Perimeter Rate Limiting: Cloudflare / AWS WAF or upstream reverse proxy enforcing strict RST_STREAM rate limits.
Protocol Restriction: Running HTTP/1.1 only on public endpoints where HTTP/2 is not strictly required.
advisories.residual_risk: None if patched. If unpatched and exposed, public attackers can exhaust worker CPU cycles.

validation_steps.purpose: Verifies exact RPM EVR to check whether version exceeds 1:1.20.1-14.el9_2.3.
Verifies whether NGINX daemon is active and listening.
Audits active configuration for HTTP/2 protocol activation.
validation_steps.expected_output: listen ... ssl http2; OR http2 on;

advisories.safe_verification_procedure: Safe Non-Destructive Verification: Execute 'curl -k -I --http2 https://localhost' to verify if server negotiates HTTP/2 via ALPN. Run 'nginx -v' to confirm build version.

advisories.title: NGINX HTTP/2 Rapid Stream Cancellation High CPU Resource Exhaustion
advisories.description: A vulnerability in NGINX HTTP/2 protocol parser allows remote attackers to cause severe CPU exhaustion by sending rapid sequences of HEADERS followed by RST_STREAM frames on active HTTP/2 listeners.
advisories.root_cause: Improper rate control over rapid stream allocation and cancellation in HTTP/2 state engine.
advisories.remediation_text: Apply updated Rocky Linux package: sudo dnf update nginx
advisories.mitigation_text: Disable HTTP/2 on listening ports by removing 'http2' parameter from listen directives in /etc/nginx/nginx.conf.
advisories.operational_impact: Requires NGINX service reload ('systemctl reload nginx'). Zero system downtime.
compensating_controls: WAF / Edge Rate Limiting: Limit stream resets per TCP connection.
Protocol Disablement: Operating solely under HTTP/1.1.
advisories.residual_risk: None if patched. If vulnerable, server worker threads can be monopolized by repetitive resets.

validation_steps.purpose: Checks installed package against fixed release 1:1.20.1-14.el9_2.3.
Verifies if NGINX process is active.

advisories.safe_verification_procedure: Safe Non-Destructive Verification: Inspect NGINX build flags using 'nginx -V' to check compiled modules and verify installed release.

advisories.title: NGINX HTTP/2 HPACK Dynamic Table State Synchronization Deserialization Flaw
advisories.description: An issue was discovered in NGINX HTTP/2 HPACK header decoder when handling fragmented literal header fields with incremental indexing, which can cause state desynchronization and worker process termination.
advisories.root_cause: Improper boundary handling in HPACK dynamic header table deserialization during fragmented literal decoding.
advisories.remediation_text: Update nginx package to fixed vendor release 1:1.20.1-14.el9_2.3 via dnf.
advisories.mitigation_text: Disable HTTP/2 protocol support in server configurations.
advisories.operational_impact: Requires NGINX service reload. No system reboot.
advisories.residual_risk: Worker crash leading to intermittent denial of service if unpatched.
advisories.safe_verification_procedure: Safe Non-Destructive Verification: Check 'nginx -v' and test configuration syntax with 'nginx -t'.

advisories.title: OpenJDK AVX-512 VBMI Base64 Decoding Out-of-Bounds Memory Corruption
advisories.description: A flaw was found in OpenJDK HotSpot JVM Base64 decoding intrinsic using AVX-512 VBMI instructions. When decoding specifically crafted Base64 streams on hardware supporting AVX-512 VBMI, memory bounds may be improperly validated leading to JVM crash or arbitrary memory disclosure.
advisories.root_cause: Missing vector bounds validation in AVX-512 VBMI vector intrinsic assembly during Base64 decode.
advisories.remediation_text: Upgrade java-17-openjdk to version 1:17.0.9-1.el9 or later using dnf.
advisories.mitigation_text: Disable the vulnerable JVM Base64 intrinsic by passing '-XX:-UseBase64Intrinsics' or disable AVX-512 via '-XX:UseAVX=2' in JAVA_OPTS.
advisories.operational_impact: Requires restarting affected Java application processes. No host reboot required.
compensating_controls: Hardware constraint: Server CPU lacking AVX-512 VBMI automatically prevents vulnerable vector code execution.
Runtime flag: Setting -XX:-UseBase64Intrinsics disables the intrinsic.
advisories.residual_risk: None if hardware lacks AVX-512 VBMI or Java 17 is not in use.

validation_steps.purpose: Verifies if CPU architecture supports AVX-512 VBMI vector extension.
validation_steps.expected_output: Empty (Absent on AMD EPYC-Milan -> Hardware Immune)

advisories.safe_verification_procedure: Safe Non-Destructive Verification: Inspect CPU flags using 'lscpu | grep -i avx512' and verify active JVM flags in running processes using 'jcmd <PID> VM.flags' or 'ps -eo pid,cmd | grep java'.
